name: main-e2e-agent-roster-seeded-hermetically
body: The two synthetic fixtures in tests/main_e2e.rs (strict_surface_fixture and the metadata_mutations_are_immediately_queryable_without_a_scan setup) seed the Agent roster through the hermetic `*.scan.jsonl` payload — `testutil::scan_checkout` reads those scan files directly and never invokes the agent frontend — so `--assigned-to agent.implementer` resolves without a real `.opencode/agents/` scan. Upgrade — switch to a committed `.opencode/agents/implementer.md` definition in the scratch tree — only if the hermetic scan harness ever gains real frontend execution.
